## Natural history notes

A small orb-weaving spider characterized by its rounded abdomen with star-like projections, mottled brown coloration, and spiny outline. In Florida, it is found in fields, prairies, marsh edges, gardens, roadsides, and other open areas with grasses or low vegetation for web attachment. It builds circular webs to capture small flying insects and often rests in vegetation or near the edge of the web during the day.
